title: Invariants for recording task run status/failure in process_task
answers: Which fields must be set when the workflow marks a run failed?
Who writes TaskRun status in process_task?
Why are terminal statuses not overwritten?
body:
- Single writer: activities/update_task_run_status.py:update_task_run_status, reached from workflow.py:ProcessTaskWorkflow._update_task_run_status. Analytics task_run_completed/failed are emitted only in _capture_terminal_analytics when old_status != input.status.
- workflow's `_track_workflow_event("task_run_failed")` in the generic except passes capture_analytics=False; flipping it double-counts.
- Terminal statuses (_TERMINAL_STATUSES: completed/failed/cancelled) are final: row read under select_for_update; a change to a different status is skipped. Same-status repeat is allowed (retry idempotent).
- Failure fields in UpdateTaskRunStatusInput: error_message (written only if truthy; truncate via error_telemetry.truncate_error_message, 500 chars tail; use Temporal cause .message, not str(ActivityError)); error_type (always set; from workflow.py:_failure_error_type; 'agent_reported', 'followup_delivery_failed'; default 'unspecified'; also passed to handle_loop_run_terminal).
- Timeouts use timeout_marker in _TERMINAL_STATE_MARKERS (timed_out_inactivity, timed_out_wall_clock, sandbox_gone); other values ignored. Wall-clock failure has deliberately no error_message. State markers go through TaskRun.update_state_atomic, not the status save.
- New input fields must be optional with defaults so in-flight workflow payloads deserialize.
- Cancellation writes status=cancelled with no error fields, before sandbox cleanup, then re-raises.
- Missing TaskRun row raises non-retryable ApplicationError type TaskRunDeletedError; status activity maximum_attempts=3, track_workflow_event 1. Analytics/loop bookkeeping wrapped in try/except so recording never fails the run.
applies: process_task workflow runs; not other temporal workflows in products/tasks.
